capabilities: Style headings, text, lists, checkboxes, quotes and callouts with sliders and color pickers
Preview changes live in a sample note in Live Preview and Reading view
Blend heading colors between two picked colors across H2 to H5
Save looks as presets or export them as CSS snippets
Toggle a black-and-white PDF mode for Export to PDF
extras: Desktop only and needs Obsidian 1.13 or later; releases are signed with build provenance attestations; no network, telemetry, or runtime dependencies; settings sit on top of the user's theme and win while enabled.
problem: Changing how notes look in Obsidian normally means writing CSS snippets and reloading to see the result.
summary: GUI style editor that styles headings, lists, checkboxes, quotes and callouts with sliders and color pickers, previewed live on a sample note.
